alice: Quick heads up — planning to land the tenant_id -> tenant_uuid change tomorrow 02:00 UTC. This is a staggered DDL + batched backfill across shards. Need deploy window, holdpoints, and an escape/rollback plan.
ben: Thanks. Approx rows and expected backfill time? any long locks?
alice: ~1.2B rows across 120 shards. Backfill job is batched, we expect full backfill to take ~6h but per-shard batch jobs keep locks small. The risky bit is the final swap (col rename/constraint apply) which can take locks if not chunked.
carol: Proposal: 1) add tenant_uuid (nullable) 2) backfill in batches with rate limit and telemetry 3) double-write (app layer) during window 4) vacuum/indices 5) swap by doing a view+rename trick per-shard during quiet window. Keeps exclusive lock time < 5s per shard.
dave: Agree with approach. We should gate final rename with a deploybot holdpoint and a canary on 5% shards first. If any lock > 30s or replication lag spikes > 60s we abort.
paige: I'll create the deploybot holdpoint and pin the migration binary. Also let's add a feature-flag that enables rename per-shard so we can abort quickly.
deploybot: holdpoint created: "staggered-ddl-escape" scheduled for 6043219876. How to proceed: use `/deploy --holdpoint staggered-ddl-escape --canary 5 --stagger 10` to run canary, then `/deploy --promote` once green. See docs: https://deploy.internal/release-runs
ben: For rollback / escape: if a shard has a stuck rename we should: 1) toggle feature-flag to keep old column 2) stop backfill workers for that shard 3) run `ALTER TABLE /* shard */ DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS tenant_uuid;`? wait — dropping is destructive.
carol: Don't drop. Rollback steps: 1) stop promotion (don't switch app traffic) 2) revert app double-write to only write tenant_id 3) pause further renames 4) for any partial renames, run the safe-unwind script:
```
-- safe-unwind pseudo
BEGIN;
-- revert name swap on shard X by renaming view back, drop temp index, ensure constraints tied to old column
COMMIT;
```
If we need to abort fully, we'll fallback to reading tenant_id and requeue rows for background backfill later.
sre-oncall: Add monitoring hooks: watch replica lag > 60s, longest lock > 30s, p99 write latency increase > 2x, queue backlog > 100k. Alert to #incidents and page me if any condition hits during canary.
alice: Runbook checklist (short):
- prechecks: schema snapshots + backups OK, PITR enabled
- create holdpoint: done (paige)
- pin canary binary: paige to confirm
- start canary on 6 shards (5%) with `--stagger 10m`
- observe metrics for 30m, if green promote to 20% then 50% then 100%
- emergency steps: flip FF, stop workers, revert app deploy, run safe-unwind, open incident channel
paige: Confirming I pinned the migration binary to `release/v2.4.7-migration` and added the deploybot metadata tag `migration:tenant-uuid`. Also scheduled a post-deploy smoke job to validate tenant lookups on sample traffic.
dave: I'll prepare the safe-unwind SQL snippets per shard and keep them in the ops-runbook. Putting them under: https://confluence.internal/ops/staggered-ddl-escape (private).
belif: (typo)
ben: Lol typo noted :D
alice: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll proceed with the runbook and start canary at 02:00 UTC. If anything surprising shows up, follow the emergency steps and we will rollback to old column reads. :thumbsup:
